title: Warm Crisp Chinese Russet Potato Chow Fun
description: A peppery and cozy Chinese dish featuring russet potato, this gluten-free friendly recipe is perfect for a cold winter night, with a crispy texture from the pan-fried potatoes and a soft chew from the chow fun noodles.

ingredients.name: russet potatoes
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into thin strips

instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and blanch the potato strips for 3 minutes, then drain and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, sesame oil, and grated ginger.
In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium-high heat and stir-fry the minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the blanched potato strips to the skillet and stir-fry for 5 minutes, or until they start to crisp up.
Add the chow fun noodles to the skillet and stir-fry for 2 minutes, or until they are well coated with the potato and garlic mixture.
Pour the soy sauce mixture into the skillet and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until the noodles are well coated.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a serving platter and garnish with chopped scallions.
